Class AtomicPreview

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.AtomicPreview
public final class AtomicPreview extends Object
Bounded compact views of the same atomic model used by the examiner. Particle preparation runs on the geometry worker; GPU resources belong to the client thread and are released on eviction or resource reload.

  • Method Details

    • supports

      public static boolean supports(MoleculeDef definition)
      Only a single real element atom has a one-to-one atomic preview. Elemental molecules such as oxygen and fullerene keep their authored molecular structure, as do crystals, polymers, and unresolved groups.
      Parameters:
      definition - definition to display
      Returns:
      whether its compact model can be replaced with an atomic view

    • draw

      public static boolean draw(MoleculeDef definition, int left, int top, int width, int height, int size, float yaw, float pitch, float panX, float panY, float zoom, int clipLeft, int clipTop, int clipRight, int clipBottom, long animationNanos)
      Renders inside the card's outer clip, using its existing molecular fit and camera.
      Parameters:
      definition - single-atom definition
      left - initial model viewport left
      top - initial model viewport top
      width - initial model viewport width
      height - initial model viewport height
      size - fitted molecular image size
      yaw - current yaw in degrees
      pitch - current pitch in degrees
      panX - camera horizontal pan
      panY - camera vertical pan
      zoom - camera zoom
      clipLeft - outer clip left
      clipTop - outer clip top
      clipRight - outer clip right
      clipBottom - outer clip bottom
      animationNanos - continuous particle animation time
      Returns:
      false while preparation is pending, so the caller can retain its solid preview
